_source: Adapted from countinghouse by Charles Zheng (MIT), https://github.com/goodnight000/countinghouse, server/src/derive.ts taxes()
_scope: Dates fit a calendar-year Delaware C-corporation. An LLC, an S-corp, a student organization or an unincorporated club has a different calendar. The source built these for a fictional company (Lumen Labs) and hard-coded 2026 to 2027 dates; they are generalized here to annual recurrences. Nothing here is legal or tax advice.
_weekends: The source lists nominal dates. The IRS generally moves a due date that falls on a weekend or legal holiday to the next business day; the script rolls weekends only and does not know holidays. Verify.

events.title: Quarterly federal payroll tax return
events.note: Covers the quarter that just ended (Q1 due Apr 30, Q2 Jul 31, Q3 Oct 31, Q4 Jan 31). A payroll provider such as Gusto usually files it; confirm deposits match.

events.title: 1099-NEC to contractors
events.note: Send to everyone paid over the threshold for the year, lawyers included. Collect a W-9 before the first payment; without one, backup withholding may apply (24 percent in the source).
events.verify: The source uses a $600 threshold. A law change may have raised it for payments after 2025: check the current IRS General Instructions for 1099-NEC.

events.title: California Statement of Information
events.note: Source: every two years, $25, update officers and address; foreign corps registered in California file too. The real due month is the incorporation anniversary month, so the Feb 28 date was specific to the demo company (incorporated Feb 14).

events.note: The default notice uses the authorized-shares method. Recompute with the assumed par value method (run: finance.py franchise-tax) and file with the lower result.

events.title: R&D tax credit
events.note: Attached to the Form 1120. A qualified small business may elect to apply up to $500,000 a year against payroll taxes. The source's rough estimate was 6.6 percent of qualified engineering wages, a modeling shortcut; have a CPA size it.
